Recommended for kernels below 5.10: patches your stock boot image with the official Magisk patcher (unmodified magiskboot + boot_patch.sh bundled in this APK). On A-only legacy SAR devices pick the recovery image instead. Flash the result via fastboot/recovery; no root needed.
This APK does not bundle the Magisk payload (magiskboot / boot_patch.sh), so the Magisk route is unavailable.
Pass KEEPVERITY=true to Magisk (keep verity instead of stripping it). Off by default, same as Magisk default.
Pass KEEPFORCEENCRYPT=true to Magisk. Off by default, same as Magisk default.
Pass PATCHVBMETAFLAG=true to Magisk. Only for devices that need the vbmeta flags patched.
Pass RECOVERYMODE=true: patch a recovery image instead of boot. Needed on A-only system-as-root devices whose boot image has no ramdisk.
Pass LEGACYSAR=true: hexpatch skip_initramfs to want_initramfs in the kernel. Auto is Magisk\'s own test (the root of /proc/mounts is /dev/root); force it on if the kernel is not detected correctly.
The below-5.10 mount-state route: root here belongs to Magisk. This page reads and writes the policy table of Magisk itself (magisk.db, policies) through the official magisk CLI.
